summary: Decomposed packages/protocol/src/index.ts (~1817 LOC) into cohesive TypeScript modules under src/ and src/requests/, with src/index.ts retained as a compatibility barrel re-exporting every existing export. Split tests/index.test.ts into tests/protocol.test.ts and tests/project-resources.test.ts. Fixed a missing non-exported constant (sessionTitleLimit) in src/core.ts that caused an initial tsc failure. Verified with pnpm check, vitest run, prettier --write, and AST/runtime export-name comparisons plus a runtime schema-hash comparison confirming identical wire schemas; protocolVersion=25 preserved.
decisions: Split index.ts by domain (core, envelopes, errors, events, extensions, git, parsers, projects, providers, registry, resources, responses, sessions) plus a requests/ subdirectory split (git, project, resources, session), keeping src/index.ts as a barrel so existing imports continue to resolve.
Preserved the non-exported sessionTitleLimit constant locally in src/core.ts after an initial tsc failure showed the AST splitter had dropped it.
Reorganized tests/ from a single tests/index.test.ts into tests/protocol.test.ts and tests/project-resources.test.ts, each kept under the 300 LOC guideline.

Verified behavior preservation by hashing all exported *Schema TypeBox values via tsx and asserting deepStrictEqual against a baseline snapshot, and by comparing getExportsOfModule symbol counts (135 old vs 135 current, no missing/extra names).
errors: Initial tsc run failed with TS2552 'Cannot find name sessionTitleLimit' in src/core.ts because the AST-based splitter had omitted the non-exported const; resolved by manually re-inserting the const declaration in src/core.ts, after which tsc passed.

An ad-hoc node -e export-comparison script failed with 'missing ) after argument list' due to a backslash-escape mistake in a heredoc string literal; rerun with corrected escaping and produced the expected {old:135,current:135,missing:[],extra:[]} result.
